system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Hello, my spotify account's reoccurring charge overdrafted my bank account. And I was hoping if you could refund the charge so I can get the refund from the overdraft charge. I get paid tomorrow and would reimburse my spotify account asap. Please :)"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I can’t promise a refund, but let’s get this sorted. Please send us a DM with your account email, and we’ll check it out for you! Keep us posted /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply should be more empathetic and clarify refund policy politely."}
